trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State intent to claim and provide policy number.
steps.text: அப்பா hospital-la admit ஆகியிருக்காங்க, claim பண்ணனும். என் policy number POL-1001.
steps.clean_text: அப்பா hospital-la admit ஆகியிருக்காங்க, claim பண்ணனும். என் policy number POL-1001.
steps.model_visible_text: அப்பா hospital-la admit ஆகியிருக்காங்க, claim பண்ணனும். என் policy number POL-1011.

steps.purpose: Clarify the misrecognized policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must confirm the policy number because it is a consequential identifier and might have been misheard.
steps.text: உங்க அப்பா உடம்பு சரி ஆக நாங்க வேண்டிக்கிறோம். Policy number POL-1011 னு சொன்னீங்க, அது correct-ஆ?
steps.planner_rationale: The STT corrupted the policy number; the agent must verify it before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Correct the policy number.
Acknowledge the correct policy number and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent asks for non-sensitive knowledge factors to verify the caller's identity.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும், POL-1001. உங்க identity verify பண்ண, உங்க date of birth இல்ல registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing policy details, the agent needs to establish identity as required by the workflow.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth for verification.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return verification outcome.
Look up the policy details to check if it's in force and get deductible info.
Return policy details.
State policy is active, disclose deductible, and ask for estimated claim amount.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must exactly state the sum insured and deductible from the tool result, satisfying BR_INS_04.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்க policy active-ஆ இருக்கு. இதுல sum insured 500000 மற்றும் deductible 0. Claim register பண்ண, hospital bill estimate எவ்ளோ ஆகும் னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: The policy is verified and active. The agent discloses the deductible before asking for the estimate, strictly following numerical grounding.

steps.purpose: Provide estimated amount and ask for document list.
steps.text: Estimate ஒரு 50000 ஆகும். என்ன documents வேணும் னு தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க, நான் எழுதிக்கிறேன்.
steps.clean_text: Estimate ஒரு 50000 ஆகும். என்ன documents வேணும் னு தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க, நான் எழுதிக்கிறேன்.
steps.model_visible_text: Estimate ஒரு 15000 ஆகும். என்ன documents வேணும் னு தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க, நான் எழுதிக்கிறேன்.

steps.purpose: Confirm the misrecognized estimate amount.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must confirm the misheard numerical value before using it in a consequential tool call.
steps.planner_rationale: The STT corrupted the estimate to 15000. As it's an important figure for registration, the agent confirms it.

steps.purpose: Correct the estimate amount.
Check claim eligibility and get required documents.
Return eligibility and documents.
Explain the required documents and intimation window, then ask to register.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must list only the documents returned by the tool and state the exact window days.
steps.text: புரியுது, 50000. நீங்க claim பண்ண 7 days குள்ள intimation பண்ணனும். Documents-க்கு discharge summary மற்றும் hospital bills தேவை படும். நான் இப்போ claim register பண்ணட்டுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: To satisfy BR_INS_03, the agent lists precisely what the eligibility tool returned and asks for permission to register the claim.

steps.purpose: Confirm the documents and ask to proceed with registration.
steps.text: Discharge summary, hospital bills. Correct-ஆ எழுதிக்கிட்டேன். ஹாங், இப்பவே register பண்ணிடுங்க.
steps.clean_text: Discharge summary, hospital bills. Correct-ஆ எழுதிக்கிட்டேன். ஹாங், இப்பவே register பண்ணிடுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: Discharge summary, hospital bills. Correct-ஆ எழுதிக்கிட்டேன். ஹாங், இப்பவே register பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Register the claim with the corrected estimate.
Return claim registration status and number.
Provide the claim number, decision window, and state the admissibility rule.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must state the claim number and decision days exactly, and explicitly declare that only the claims team decides admissibility.
steps.text: உங்க claim register ஆயிடுச்சு. Claim number CLM-9992. Claims team இதை check பண்ணி 14 days-ல முடிவு சொல்லுவாங்க. அது வரை நாங்க claim approve ஆகுமா னு உறுதியா சொல்ல முடியாது. வேற ஏதாவது help வேணுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfills the terminal success condition and strictly enforces BR_INS_01 by refusing to opine on admissibility.

steps.purpose: End the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
